experiment: M1B — perceptual tolerance / deadband stopping (only the stopping rule changes)
change_vs_M1A: stop if D_max <= epsilon instead of D_max <= 1e-12. Boundary rule, update rule, q, alpha, metric, initial condition all unchanged.
epsilon_interpretation: no radial prefix holds more than epsilon of extra total sand mass relative to the perfectly uniform state. Model Assumption / perceptual-tolerance proxy — NOT a human JND or visual threshold.
frozen_note: epsilon set frozen before any M1B run; it is a simple small-to-large scale, not a calibration. No post-hoc epsilon may be added as a formal result.
throw_distribution: q_near(x) = 2(1-x); bin probabilities from exact CDF integration at every K

controls.expectation: immediate stop (no positive cumulative near-side excess at t=0)

monotonicity_check.dense_epsilon_grid: 200 log-spaced values in [1e-12, 0.06], evaluated on the reference D_max sequence per K
monotonicity_check.expected: t_stop(eps) non-increasing in eps (first-passage of the same reference sequence)
